title: Expectation and Variance
author: oA7a2DXCeN3DLamvj
chapter_outcomes: Use a probability density function which may be defined piecewise
Use the general result $\text{E}(g(X)) = \int f(x)g(x)dx$ where $f(x)$ is the probability density function of the continuous random variable $X$ and $g(X)$ is a function of $X$
Understand and use the relationship between the probability density function (PDF) and the cumulative distribution function (CDF), and use either to evaluate probabilities or percentiles
Use cumulative distribution functions (CDFs) of related variables in simple cases
